bb9c27a1: /* ;
 .;Main loop that processes each element of the UTILITY file.
 .;First, call the HEAD tag to print header information.
 .;Then loop through each element in the UTILITY file,
 .;executing the code segment specified by the DGJTL variable.
 .;If the DGU flag is set, exit the loop.
 .;*/
7a25c4a2: ;Set DGJTF flag to 1, execute code segment specified by DGJTL, exit loop if DGU flag is set.
72c51c77: ;If DGJTLPG is not 1 and the UTILITY file exists, call the RET tag. If DGU flag is set, exit. Otherwise, call ^DGJOTP3.
7e8fa982: ;Exit and return control to the DGJOTP routine.
62aae6b8: ;Write the first 3 characters of the name from the 'HEALTH FACTORS' file if it is defined.
4f021cb2: ;If the direction is 2 (descending) write undict, dictat, transc, or signed based on the value in the 11th piece.
dcbfd722: ;Get the date from the DATE field. If undefined, set it to null.
3ab49ade: ;If the date is defined, format it and replace spaces with 0s and write it.
923b5a8b: ;Write the length value from the 2nd piece of DGJTDL.
b48fbfdc: ;Write the length value from the 3rd piece of DGJTDL.
6448bf02: ;Write the length value from the 4th piece of DGJTDL.
100dc10e: ;Calculate the sum of the length fields, write it, and add it to DGJDYAVG.
9c0a2398: ;If the sum is greater than 30, subtract 30 and write it. Add it to DGJ30AVG.
994105f3: ;End of the routine.
5373d0d5: Assigns the value of DGJTDV to variable DGJTDV1 and quits.
f4e0550e: Writes a header line for the Pending Status section and quits.
204128fc: Quits the routine.
66d46f2c: Formats the DGJTDT date into the format 'MM/DD/YYYY' and removes any spaces from the formatted date string.
5992dea5: If DGJTFF is false, calls the HDR subroutine.

85bfdeeb: Loops through physicians, patients, and associated entries in the ^UTILITY("VAS",$J,DGJTDV,DGJTPHY,DGJTPT) global. For each entry, it calls the RET subroutine if DGJTFF is true, calls the HEAD and HDR subroutines if DGJTFF is true, calls the HDR1 subroutine, sets DGJTFF to true, and calls the PHY1 subroutine. The loop exits if DGU is true or if there are no more entries.
d9033edb: Quits the routine.

31afb61a: Loops through patients (DFN) and associated entries (IFN) in the ^UTILITY("VAS",$J,DGJTDV,DGJTPHY,DGJTPT) global. For each entry, it sets DGJTDL to the value of ^(IFN), calls the SET subroutine, checks if the entry exists in the ^VAS(393 global, and if so, calls the PRT2 subroutine. If DGU is true, the loop exits. After processing each entry, it calls the PH^DGJOTP3 subroutine.
9064b98a: Quits the routine.
f99c65c3: ;Call header routines if this is the first patient.
54391559: ;For each procedure - call header routines and display serialized data.
6e05ffdb: ;Exit routine.
bb84569b: Loop through the Visit order file by entry, quitting if Visit order file entry is null or a Utility flag is set.
bdc36be3: Quit the routine.
9f38bda4: Loop through Visits for each patient, getting Visit data and setting flags. If the file entry exists in the Patient file, print data, quitting if a Utility flag is set. Store data.
6f238a51: Quit the subroutine.
148c7327: Get the zero node of the visit.

1e6c6308: If the visit is not a physician visit, set the physician code to 14 and get the physician name from the NEW PERSON file (#200) in that node position. If no name is found, print 'NOT SPECIFIED'.
2201b8d3: If the visit is a physician visit, print the first 20 characters of the patient name.
6a2ee525: If the visit is a service visit, print the first 16 characters of the patient name.
f0dbc21e: Print the patient ID number at the appropriate column position based on visit type.
e214f15f: Get the visit date from the zero node and print it at the appropriate column position based on visit type after formatting it with the DATE routine.
d22f2104: Print the first 12 characters of the clinic name from the HOSPITAL LOCATION file (#44) at the appropriate column position based on visit type. If no clinic is found, leave it blank.
d8fcb99b: If the visit is a service visit, print the first 10 characters of the physician name. Call the HD1 routine and quit.
